$comment: cards: podium's record of each session's results card, so a session.ended delivered again posts nothing (paddock#67). One key per session, <src>.<sid>, written only by podium: posting (create-only) before it sends, posted (with a revision check) once Discord has the card. The keys and the value, CardRecord, are contracts' (subjects.yaml).
This file is not a stream config: bootstrap.sh turns each field into the flag of the same name for nats kv add and nats kv edit.
history 1: podium reads only the current value; the revision check on the posted write needs no history.
max_value_size 64 KiB (65536): a value is a CardRecord as protobuf JSON, about 200 bytes. 64 KiB still refuses a mistaken write of something session-sized.

max_bucket_size 64 MiB (67108864): a key per session that gets a card, a few hundred bytes each, so years of racing and replays fill a few MB. The limit is a backstop so the bucket cannot fill the disk.
No ttl: a key must outlive the session.ended it answers, which EVENTS keeps 30 days, and a key gone early would let a replayed session.ended post its card again.
Discard and duplicate window are not set here: nats kv add fixes them for every bucket (discard new, so a full bucket refuses a write, and podium posts nothing it cannot record).
replicas 1: one NATS server (ADR 0004). File storage, since the bucket exists to outlive a restart.
description: podium's record of each session's results card (paddock#67).
